notes: 'again' belongs to the שׁוּב polel unit under rule 44: 'restore' writes the lexeme, but the repetition 'again' states is the return שׁוּב itself writes, so the second surplus condition (a repetition the Hebrew does not write) fails and the ASV has rendered one lexeme twice, as 'did work' renders עָשָׂה. Corpus keeps 'again' with שׁוּב throughout (again 28, turn again 20, bring again 11).
